maddeler.e:
نجتنب (form VIII)
# نَجْتَنِبُ (najtanibu) /nad͡ʒ.ta.ni.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِجْتَنَبَ (ijtanaba)
# نُجْتَنَبُ (nujtanabu) /nud͡ʒ.ta.na.bu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَنَبَ (ijtanaba)
# نَجْتَنِبَ (najtaniba) /nad͡ʒ.ta.ni.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِجْتَنَبَ (ijtanaba)
# نُجْتَنَبَ (nujtanaba) /nud͡ʒ.ta.
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
